name: purview
description: Deploys a Microsoft Purview account using the AVM-backed module with environment-aware parameters.
what: A Microsoft Purview account (Microsoft.Purview/accounts) that supports data governance and catalog workloads with configurable network posture.
why: Organizations implementing data governance need a repeatable way to provision Purview accounts with consistent baseline configuration across environments.
potentialUseCases: Standing up an initial Purview governance environment
Provisioning separate dev and prod Purview accounts
Applying consistent network settings to Purview deployments

reliability: Purview account deployments are repeatable via IaC
security: Network access posture is explicitly parameterized
No hardcoded credentials in deployment templates
costOptimization: Dev and prod parameter profiles support staged adoption
Single module wrapper avoids duplicated template maintenance
operationalExcellence: Standardized outputs expose account and managed resource details
performanceEfficiency: Deploy Purview in supported region with configurable settings
Scalable governance foundation without template rewrites

quota.summary: Purview account availability and features can vary by region and subscription.

requirements.detail: Confirm Purview account creation is enabled for your subscription in the chosen region.

components.name: Purview Data Map (1 capacity unit, always on)
components.notes: One always-on Data Map capacity unit x 730 hours.

components.name: Purview scanning (vCore)
components.notes: Assumes ~40 scanning vCore-hours/month; scales with scan frequency and source size.
